correction.reason: The four-column table was misread. XRP has a check mark under Cross Collateral Currency and a dash under Offset Currency.

findings.claim: XRP is a full Deribit cross-collateral currency, not an offset currency. The September 28 table marks Cross Collateral Currency ✓ and Offset Currency –.
The XRP row shows no X:PM haircut stated and a 15% X:SM haircut.
The 21:50 revision's assertion that XRP is also an offset currency is withdrawn. Do not use that field or graph edge; this 22:05 correction is authoritative.
